blocks.x: What do you do when you’ve got two actors, a bunch of dialogue, and only enough time to get one camera angle? Consider one of the oldest tools in the filmmaking toolbox: the sustained two-shot.
Part of a limited series of new video essays.

To read more about the two-shot, from the late David Bordwell:
http://www.davidbordwell.net/blog/2013/10/07/where-did-the-two-shot-go-here/

Written by Taylor Ramos & Tony Zhou
Edited & Narrated by Tony Zhou
Music by Sean William
BTS footage filmed by Julie Ng
